revisions.author: FID Rayhan
revisions.description: Rewritten at business level like the Part List Upload: trigger [Validate file] of the Mapping per Destination screen, no temp table, tables TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE (part number level) and TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE_DEST (part number + period + destination level), row rules 1-7, placeholder rows, sample scenarios. No external document references.

objective: To process the destination mapping file uploaded from the Crossdock Master Setting - Mapping per Destination screen: from the [Validate file] button of the Upload Excel modal until the mapping of the ongoing calculation period is saved to TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE_DEST.
In case any error occurs, nothing is saved. The error is recorded in the upload log and a result report is created.

inputs.description: Uploaded by the D/S user on the Mapping per Destination screen ([Validate file]). Only sheet Upload is read. Max 5 MB, 5,000 rows.

rows: Starts when the user clicks [Validate file] in the Upload Excel modal of the Mapping per Destination screen (on demand, no schedule). The button is enabled only for the ongoing period.

constraints: Data level: TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE (Part List) is at part number level (key PART_NO). TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE_DEST (Mapping per Destination) is at part number + calculation period + destination level (key PART_NO, PERIOD, DEST_CODE).
Only the ongoing calculation period is changed. Past periods are read only.
Names TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE and TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE_DEST are as given; the upload log name is proposed and the destination master table is TBD.
Upload template: sheet Upload is prefilled by Export Excel (ongoing period selected) with every Active part. Parts not in the file are not changed.
Change history of the mapping is not included yet. TBD: history table, logged events and retention are not decided.

steps: User clicks [Validate file] in the Upload Excel modal of the Mapping per Destination screen (ongoing period). The batch starts and receives the uploaded file.

steps.text: Check the file: format .xlsx, size, number of rows, sheet "Upload" and template columns (see 4.1).
children: If the file is not valid, reject the upload and go to step 7.

steps: Read all rows of sheet "Upload" and group them by part_no.

steps.text: Check every row and every part against the business rules (see 4.2) and collect all errors.
children: A placeholder row (dest_code and case_day both blank) is skipped.

steps.text: If any row has an error, reject the whole file. Nothing is saved and the errors are recorded in the upload log.
If all rows are valid, compare each part with its current mapping of the ongoing period (see 4.3).
children: Same destinations and Case/Day: skip the part (no change).
Otherwise: replace the mapping of the part by the rows of the file and set Sync Status = No Sync.
A part whose rows are all blank is not changed.

steps: Create the result report and record the result (completed or rejected) in the upload log. The Mapping per Destination screen shows the result to the user. Exit.

func_desc.text: This batch starts when the user clicks [Validate file] in the Upload Excel modal of the Mapping per Destination screen. It checks the uploaded file and, if everything is valid, replaces the mapping of the changed parts for the ongoing calculation period. If not, the upload is rejected and recorded in the upload log.

items: Only sheet "Upload" of the file is read. Parts that are not in the sheet are not changed.
Only the ongoing calculation period is changed; past periods are read only.
One run saves all parts or none (all-or-nothing).
The column total_case_day is for reference only and is not read; the limit is Max Case/Day of the part in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE.
File size is 5 MB or less.
Sheet Upload has 1 to 5,000 data rows.
Sheet "Upload" exists. Other sheets are ignored.
Header has the 4 template columns (see Appendix). Extra columns are ignored.

func_desc.text: Every row is checked and all errors are collected, so the user can correct the file once. Checks 4 and 6 are done per part (all rows with the same part_no).

items: If any row is rejected, nothing is saved. The upload status and the error of every row are recorded in the upload log (TB_R_CD_UPLOAD_LOG).

If all rows are valid, each part in the file is compared with its current mapping of the ongoing period. A part with the same destinations and Case/Day is skipped (no change); its Sync Status and last update stay.

For a changed part, all its rows of the ongoing period in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE_DEST are replaced by the rows of the file: destinations in the file are inserted or updated, destinations not in the file are removed.
A part whose rows are all blank (placeholder) is not changed, so a mapping cannot be removed completely by upload (same as the screen: at least one destination).
Every changed part gets Sync Status = No Sync in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE. Sync is done manually by D/S on the screen.
A result report (.xlsx) is created for both cases.

rows: Part No exists in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE and its status is Active.
Destination code exists in the destination master.
case_day is a whole number greater than 0 when dest_code is filled.
A destination code appears only once per part in the file.
dest_code and case_day are both filled, or both blank (placeholder row). Only one of the two filled is an error.
The total case_day of all rows of a part does not exceed the Max Case/Day of the part in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE (total_case_day of the file is ignored). Below or equal is allowed.
The upload is for the ongoing calculation period only (the screen enables [Validate file] only for that period).
